label: M15_mode2_lucky_base_v6
_note: M15 mode 2 BASE game target (v6, 2026-04-23 — hit-rate-corrected).
IMPORTANT — this target covers BASE GAME RTP only (no Bonus feature).
Feature Play contributes 164.98pp separately via per-mode feature_params
override in mode_2/weights.json (trigger 2.75% × EV 60 = 165pp).
Total machine RTP = base 135pp + feature 165pp = 300%.
v6 change vs v5 (per project_slot_designer_hit_rate_deviation.md):
v5 set hit_rate=0.3596 (mode 1 × 3.16 proportional to RTP scaling).
Player-experience review: 36% hit = 'sugar overload', not 'lucky +50%'.
v6 locks hit_rate to 0.225 (mode 1 × 1.7, within user-specified 20-25%
band). RTP delta goes into bucket-shape shift (more weight in mid/high
buckets) rather than hit frequency inflation.
v6 design brief:
- Total RTP: 300% (mode 2 幸运 / lucky mode)
- Base : Feature split = 45 : 55 (same ratio as mode 1)
- mode 2 vs mode 1:
* feature EV 1.30× (46 → 60, within brief's ≤1.5× cap)
* per-hit avg win 1.85× (3.26× → 6.0×) — this is where RTP delta lands
- 独立 archetype: Phase 4 tune (NOT a derivation of mode 1 weights).
但 strip layout 跟 mode 1 完全一致（byte-identical reel_strips.json）。
Bucket shape: use mode 1's shape as JS-divergence template (shape-only,
normalized — magnitudes enforced separately via rtp_pct + hit_rate).
Tuner will shift weight toward mid/high buckets to hit 135pp at 22.5% hit
(≈6× avg mult per hit vs mode 1's 3.3×).
Feature params (lives in mode_2/weights.json feature_params block, NOT here):
x_count_weights: (5, 40, 40, 12, 3)   # same as mode 1 (locked)
y_count_weights: (60, 30, 10)          # mode 2 widened vs mode 1's (75,20,5)
x_value_weights: (0.0009, 0.0914, ...) # mode 2 pushes more mid cards
accept_threshold: 40, max_rounds: 4

_design_constraints.variance_target: base cv ~5 (lower than mode 1 due to higher hit rate), feature conditional CV ~0.78
_tune_notes: Run Phase 4 count tuning with --sa-steps 0 to prevent Phase 5 from touching shared strips.
Strips are locked to mode 1's (byte-identical reel_strips.json).
Only per-position weights can change; positions + symbol layout frozen.
If Phase 5 ran, joint SA would co-swap positions across all sibling modes' weights → breaks mode 1's existing rawdata + violates strips-identical-across-modes invariant.
